crowd.line: Analysts lean defensive: 0 bullish · 3 neutral · 2 bearish
crowd.vs_dashboard: Diverges from the dashboard's Cautious regime

items.name: glassnode
items.takeaway: Short-term holders taking profit sent the biggest share of exchange inflows in a year and weighed on price, but that flow has now cooled back to its yearly average.

items.name: glassnode
items.takeaway: Altcoin leverage is still elevated: over 40% of large caps sit near their highest leverage of the year despite lower prices, so a deeper drop would put many longs at risk.

items.name: ecoinometrics
items.takeaway: The Nasdaq 100 fell 5.5% in its worst week in a decade, yet Bitcoin held around $82K above its 200-day average, roughly where ETF demand says it should trade.

items.name: Axel 💎🙌 Adler Jr
items.takeaway: Long-term holders have trimmed 345K BTC since late July; they were selling almost daily in early October, but the pace has slowed.

items.name: Darkfost
items.takeaway: Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw a slightly negative week, and a little over 10,000 BTC has left them over the last two weeks, a sign ETF demand has slowed.
